propositions: The plan-writing guide documents criteria but names no coaching moves, leaving coached authors without a lookup reference for techniques they are advised to apply.

The top five coaching moves by field frequency (specification-by-example, plan-the-verification, riskiest-assumption-test, state-attestation-evidence, propagate-to-children) must appear in the guide with technique descriptions and before/after examples.
The [operator-attested] AC tag used in state-attestation-evidence coaching must be documented in the guide so authors recognize and apply it correctly.
All move names in the guide must match the MOVE_REGISTRY spellings exactly to ensure consistency and testability.
